body:
## Description

Members now shows the trusted workspace name beside Switch workspace, with clear Connect, Members and Audit logs page links. The shared shell uses a 32px title, visible keyboard focus and a working skip link; Members uses the full content width. This implements UI-01 of the approved Refined tabs plan.

The existing overview supplies the name, which is escaped before display. Audit logs keeps its form, optional script and Save/Test behavior. Existing invitation and pending sections remain visible; UI-02/03/04 are still planned. The PR also saves the reviewed UI plan and implementation record.

## Review

**T1 Team review**  
Architecture: **T0: no architecture fact**  
The browser inventory update in `docs/implementation/test-gate-policy.md` selects T1 through the checker’s `read_paths` rule.

Architecture facts (candidate `a017020e` vs main `57c99e2b`):

- None.

Why, from `.pr-impact.json`: all impact flags are false. Production architecture is unchanged: the existing Web owner renders trusted display data without new provider reads, public declarations, storage, dependencies or deployment boundaries. Access checks, protected forms, session/removal outcomes and exact-byte CSP hashes remain intact.

The complete ordinary suite, focused browser checks, type/build checks and both container gates passed. Quality findings are retained with documented reasons; no metric exception is used. Independent agent and manager review found no remaining actionable issue.

**Merge status: blocked pending current-candidate owner/team approval (T1).** The checker has no local blocker. No other decision is outstanding. [Full evidence and previews](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/4c4b5e15e4203548da6977fc0636334ef8fb8af4/review-evidence/ui-01/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/README.md).

## Quality review

Candidate: `a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1`. Base/main: `57c99e2b892acea52bfc3a53aee61b5ae442bf46`. **T1 Team review; overall merge blocked pending current-candidate owner/team approval.** [Final checker](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/4c4b5e15e4203548da6977fc0636334ef8fb8af4/review-evidence/ui-01/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/validation/review-check.json) has no local blocker. Independent agent and manager review are complete; they are not human approval.

The only tier reason is `read_paths` for `docs/implementation/test-gate-policy.md`: one inventory row now describes the expanded browser coverage. It changes no command, gate selection or decision authority, so the semantic policy flag stays false. All committed impact flags are false; uncertainty is false. There are no additional policy questions or undeclared facts.

### Quality findings

- Existing production MI is **61.312→61.251** in `administration-pages.ts` and **81.001→80.370** in `members-page-layout.ts`. Neither file is new or drops five points. The changed renderer keeps 3 paths/17 lines; the layout’s 7→8 paths reflect the optional escaped display name. Keep the cohesive markup, escaping and CSP ownership; extra helpers would add indirection without reducing decisions. The CSS literal has no scored function. No metric exception is used.
- Changed-function CRAP passes: `membersPage` **12** at measured 0% unit coverage (its feature proof is integration/browser), layout **8** at 95.7%, and a mechanically new anonymous row **1** at 100%. Seven unmeasured anonymous rows are unchanged by this PR; that reason is retained. No required unknown assessment/identity, known limit violation or target miss remains. [Full CRAP](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/4c4b5e15e4203548da6977fc0636334ef8fb8af4/review-evidence/ui-01/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/ast-report/crap.json).
- Retain the **high test-file MI 33→28** finding: the 170-line browser acceptance file expresses the required viewport/JS matrix, tablet regression and Audit Save/Test journey. Focused drivers remove complexity/non-null findings while keeping fresh state and observable assertions. Further extraction would obscure the user journey. Test files have no production MI goal.
- Retain low Halstead estimates **1.30→1.80** in `hosted-members.test.ts` and **2.56→2.83** in the route integration file: added assertions cover real page navigation and trusted-name escaping in their proper test groups. The browser file also improves its Halstead estimate 0.72→0.43. No scenario was dropped: the lexical checker’s removed test name is the retained removal journey narrowed from 390px to 320px; the new matrix runs four cases. No skip/todo remains.
- The process completed all four stages: Delta/Review report the retained goal misses above; CRAP/Architecture pass. This is not a tool failure. [Full process](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/4c4b5e15e4203548da6977fc0636334ef8fb8af4/review-evidence/ui-01/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/ast-report/process.md), [machine report](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/4c4b5e15e4203548da6977fc0636334ef8fb8af4/review-evidence/ui-01/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/ast-report/process.json), [full findings](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/4c4b5e15e4203548da6977fc0636334ef8fb8af4/review-evidence/ui-01/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/ast-report/review.md), [snapshots and coverage](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/tree/4c4b5e15e4203548da6977fc0636334ef8fb8af4/review-evidence/ui-01/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/ast-report) preserve the wider context without repeating inherited tables here.

**Habit-hooks:** passed on the complete candidate. The browser complexity and non-null findings were corrected. Keep two source comments because they explain complete-read failure atomicity and exact CSS/CSP hash ownership. Snooze is empty; no suppression was added. The final checker’s `skip` false positive was resolved by a local binding rename, with all seven browser cases and typecheck rerun.

**Informational note:** “49 public modules, 0 snapshots changed.” This confirms the unchanged public declarations. The emitter ignored 33 diagnostics in two unlisted files under its documented public-surface policy; full application typecheck passed. [Emitter log](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/4c4b5e15e4203548da6977fc0636334ef8fb8af4/review-evidence/ui-01/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/validation/review-check.stderr.log). The preliminary-local-eligibility note is satisfied by manager review of the retained checks and holds; required human approval is still absent and therefore blocks merge.

<details><summary>Architecture provenance and review</summary>

The [base registry](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/57c99e2b892acea52bfc3a53aee61b5ae442bf46/architecture/components.md) and [candidate registry](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/architecture/components.md) have byte-identical prose and all 15 Mermaid views. Relevant views cover hosted containers, Web/authentication, member reads, removal, Audit settings, resource ownership and deployment. [Registry evidence](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/4c4b5e15e4203548da6977fc0636334ef8fb8af4/review-evidence/ui-01/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/validation/registry-review.json), [manager assessment](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/4c4b5e15e4203548da6977fc0636334ef8fb8af4/review-evidence/ui-01/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/validation/manager-review.md), [committed impact declaration](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/.pr-impact.json).

The [Members renderer](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/src/interfaces/web/account/administration-pages.ts) passes the already-read trusted name to the [private layout](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/src/interfaces/web/account/members-page-layout.ts). Escaping, ordinary links and current-page semantics remain at Web. No new import, provider call, permission/mutation/session/seat change, public declaration or deployment effect is introduced. Audit keeps its existing context and script; CSS/script CSP hashes still derive from the actual bytes.

No comparison drawing is needed for unchanged production architecture. The strongest changed callable is the private layout options object; the existing L3 views plus origin/escaping/caller notes answer its review question, so L4 would add no useful boundary detail.

The full metrics graph retains the unchanged unresolved `main.ts`→`style.css` import on both revisions. It cannot prove a globally complete dependency graph and withholds comparisons that need one. Manual inspection of the changed source, unchanged registry and unchanged imports supports the bounded no-new-edge conclusion.

Independent review found and corrected the Audit tablet width regression; a failing-before/passing-after test and normal-width screenshot verify the fix. Manager inspected desktop/mobile Members, expanded Audit help, tablet geometry, fonts, focus and contrast. Final independent review signed off `a017020e`; no actionable finding remains.

</details>

[Evidence index](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/4c4b5e15e4203548da6977fc0636334ef8fb8af4/review-evidence/ui-01/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/README.md) · [prior report history](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/4c4b5e15e4203548da6977fc0636334ef8fb8af4/review-evidence/ui-01/a017020ebe2448f5de6cc7d9cbb0700367fc80b1/validation/pr-history-before-final.json). No approval or de-escalation is claimed.
